record.description: Exact higher-dimensional representation supporting icosahedral/quasiperiodic projections in the vector substrate program. Its software realization is distinct from a measured six-dimensional AI state.
record.note: A split of six-dimensional real space into complementary three-dimensional subspaces is standard structure. For a cut-and-project construction, the projection matrices and lattice conditions do the work. Merely naming the subspaces gives neither an implemented encoder nor a measured geometry for an AI system.
